evidence_quotes: Syensqo, a Belgian science and technology powerhouse, faced challenges in managing and utilizing vast amounts of internal data efficiently. The company needed a robust, secure, and scalable AI solution to enhance data access and operational efficiency. The existing systems were not capable of meeting these demands, leading to inefficiencies and delays in their operation.

This comprehensive solution enabled Syensqo to enhance their data processing capabilities and improve overall efficiency. They experienced improved data processing efficiency, leading to faster decision-making and reduced operational delays.
Syensqo chose to implement Microsoft's Azure OpenAI Service to address their challenges.

The Azure OpenAI Service offered advanced capabilities, including GPT models for natural language processing, Cosmos DB for data management, and API Management for seamless integration with other systems.
Syensqo.AI, a division started only six months ago by the Belgian science and technology powerhouse Syensqo, has developed SyGPT, an advanced AI chatbot powered by Azure OpenAI Service.
